Playerdis.name: Stanley Nwabali
Playerdis.dic: Stanley Nwabali is a Nigerian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Chippa United in South Africa’s Premier Soccer League. He was born in Rivers State but hails from Imo State. At 27 years old, he has gained recognition for his performances with the Nigerian national team, the Super Eagles, particularly during the 2024 Africa Cup of Nations AFCON,Nwabali originally started his football career as a striker before transitioning to a goalkeeper. He played for several Nigerian clubs, including Go Round FC, Enyimba, and Lobi Stars, before moving to South Africa in 2022,Regarding his salary, there is no publicly available information on his exact earnings at Chippa United. However, it is reported that he is attracting interest from clubs outside South Africa, which could lead to a more lucrative contract in the future​

Playerdis.name: Amas Obasogie
Playerdis.c: Amas Obasogie is a Nigerian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper. He was born on December 27, 1999, in Benin City, Nigeria, and is currently 25 years old. Obasogie has gained recognition for his performances in goal, particularly during his time with Bendel Insurance, where he helped the team win the Nigeria Federation Cup in 2023.e recently signed with Singida Black Stars, a club in Tanzania, after a short stint with Ethiopian side Fasil Ketema FC. Before that, he played in the Nigeria Premier Football League (NPFL) and set a record for 18 clean sheets in a season. His strong performances earned him a call-up to the Nigerian national team, the Super Eagles, for the 2026 FIFA World Cup qualifiers against Lesotho and Zimbabwe

Playerdis.name: Kayode Bankole
Playerdis.dic: Kayode Bankole is a Nigerian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Remo Stars FC in the Nigeria Premier Football League (NPFL). He was born on October 16, 2002, making him 22 years old. Bankole has also been called up to the Nigerian national team, the Super Eagles, and is recognized for his impressive performances at the club level​

Playerdis.name: William Ekong
Playerdis.dic: William Troost-Ekong is a Nigerian professional footballer who plays as a center-back for Al-Kholood in the Saudi Pro League. He was born on September 1, 1993, in Haarlem, Netherlands, and is currently 31 years old. Troost-Ekong has had an extensive career, playing for clubs such as Watford, Udinese, and PAOK before moving to Al-Kholood in August 2024. He has been a key player for the Nigerian national team, earning over 70 caps and captaining the squad in multiple tournaments, including the Africa Cup of Nations (AFCON), where he won the Player of the Tournament award in 2024

Playerdis.name: Bright Osayi
Playerdis.dic: Bright Osayi-Samuel is a Nigerian professional footballer who plays as a right-back for Fenerbahçe in the Turkish Süper Lig. He was born on December 31, 1997, making him 27 years old. Osayi-Samuel started his career at Blackpool before moving to Queens Park Rangers (QPR) and later transferring to Fenerbahçe in 2021.His current contract with Fenerbahçe runs until June 30, 2025, and he earns an estimated annual salary of €3,000,000, which translates to around €57,692 per week

Playerdis.name: Bruno Onyemaechi
Playerdis.dic: Bruno Onyemaechi is a Nigerian footballer born on April 3, 1999. He plays as a left-back or center-back for Boavista in Portugal's Primeira Liga.He began his professional career at Feirense and later moved to Boavista, initially on loan before securing a permanent transfer in 2023. Onyemaechi has also represented Nigeria's Super Eagles, making his international debut in 2023.Regarding his earnings, Onyemaechi earns €2,115 per week, amounting to €110,000 per year, with his contract running until 2025​

Playerdis.name: Calvib Basey
Playerdis.dic: Calvin Bassey is a Nigerian professional footballer who plays as a center-back for Fulham FC in the English Premier League. He was born on December 31, 1999, making him 24 years old as of 2024. Bassey started his professional career at Leicester City before moving to Rangers in 2020, then to Ajax in 2022, and finally to Fulham in 2023 for a transfer fee of €21 million.Calvin Bassey is a Nigerian professional footballer who plays as a center-back and left-back for Fulham in the English Premier League. Born on December 31, 1999, in Aosta, Italy, Bassey has represented the Nigerian national team since 2021. He began his career at Leicester City's youth academy before moving to Rangers in 2020, where he won the Scottish Premiership and reached the UEFA Europa League final. He later played for Ajax before transferring to Fulham in 2023​TRANSFERMARKT.COM THECITYCELEB.COM.Bassey earns a weekly salary of approximately €51,799, which amounts to an annual salary of around €2.69 million​

Playerdis.name: Olaoluwa Aina
Playerdis.dic: He started his career at Chelsea's youth academy and later played for clubs like Torino and Fulham before joining Nottingham Forest. Internationally, he originally represented England at the youth level but switched allegiance to Nigeria in 2017 and has been a key player for the Super Eagles, including in multiple Africa Cup of Nations tournaments.Ola Aina, whose full name is Temitayo Olufisayo Olaoluwa Aina, was born on October 8, 1996, making him 28 years old. He is a Nigerian professional footballer who currently plays as a defender for Nottingham Forest in the English Premier League. Aina is known for his versatility, as he can play as a right-back, left-back, or wing-back.

Playerdis.name: Igoh Ogbu
Playerdis.dic: Igoh Ogbu is a Nigerian professional footballer who plays as a center-back for Slavia Prague in the Czech First League. Born on February 8, 2000, he is currently 24 years old. Ogbu started his professional career at Gombe United in Nigeria before moving to Rosenborg BK in Norway. He also had stints with Sogndal and Lillestrøm SK before joining Slavia Prague in January 2023.Throughout his career, he has played in multiple competitions, including the UEFA Champions League and Europa League qualifiers. He was also part of Nigeria’s U-20 team at the 2019 Africa U-20 Cup of Nations and the FIFA U-20 World Cup​,At Slavia Prague, he has made over 60 league appearances and helped the team win the 2022–23 Czech Cup​​

Playerdis.name: Wilfred Ndidi
Playerdis.dic: Wilfred Ndidi is a Nigerian professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Leicester City in the English Premier League. Born on December 16, 1996, he is currently 28 years old. Ndidi has been a key player for both his club and the Nigerian national team, known for his strong tackling ability and defensive contributions.At Leicester City, he has made over 240 appearances since joining in 2017 from Belgian club Genk. He was part of the squad that won the FA Cup in 2021 and the EFL Championship in the 2023/24 season. His current annual salary is approximately €4.52 million ($4.9 million), and his market value as of May 2024 is estimated at €16 million, though it was once as high as €60 million

Playerdis.name: Rapheal Onyedika
Playerdis.dic: Raphael Onyedika is a Nigerian professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Club Brugge in the Belgian Pro League. Born on April 19, 2001, he is currently 23 years old. Onyedika joined Club Brugge in August 2022 and is under contract until June 30, 2027. He has won the Belgian league title (2023/24) and previously played for FC Midtjylland, where he won the Danish Cup (2021/22).For Club Brugge, he has been a key player in midfield, making 21 starts in the 2024-25 Belgian Pro League season with one goal and one assist so far​

Playerdis.name: Alhassan Yusuf
Playerdis.dic: Alhassan Yusuf is a Nigerian professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder. He was born on July 18, 2000, making him 24 years old. Currently, he plays for New England Revolution in Major League Soccer (MLS) after joining the club on August 12, 2024. His contract runs until December 31, 2027, with a one-year club option​.Throughout his career, he has played for IFK Göteborg in Sweden and Royal Antwerp in Belgium, where he won multiple domestic titles, including the Belgian Pro League and Belgian Cup. He was also part of Nigeria’s squad that finished as runners-up in the 2023 Africa Cup of Nations (AFCON)​

Playerdis.name: Alex Iwobi
Playerdis.dis: Alex Iwobi is a Nigerian professional footballer who plays as a forward or attacking midfielder for Fulham in the English Premier League. Born on May 3, 1996, he is currently 28 years old.Iwobi started his senior career with Arsenal, winning the FA Cup in 2017 and two English Super Cups (2015, 2017). He later moved to Everton before joining Fulham in 2023, where he is under contract until 2028​.For the 2024/2025 season, Iwobi has played 37 matches across all competitions, scoring 7 goals and providing 4 assists​FOOTYSTATS.ORG. His annual salary at Fulham is €4.8 million.nternationally, Iwobi represents Nigeria, earning over 80 caps and scoring 10 goals. He has participated in three Africa Cup of Nations tournaments (2019, 2022, and 2024) and was part of Nigeria’s squad at the 2018 FIFA World Cup

Playerdis.name: Joseph  Aribo
Playerdis.dic: Joseph Oluwaseyi Temitope Ayodele-Aribo, commonly known as Joe Aribo, is a Nigerian professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for Southampton in the English Championship. Born on July 21, 1996, he is currently 28 years old. Aribo joined Southampton from Rangers in July 2022, signing a contract that runs until June 2026.At the international level, Aribo represents the Nigerian national team and has earned 34 caps, scoring two goals. His market value is estimated at around €7.1 million​

Playerdis.name: Papa Daniel
Playerdis.dic: Papa Daniel is a Nigerian footballer who plays as a central midfielder for Niger Tornadoes in the Nigeria Professional Football League (NPFL). He was born on January 1, 2002, making him 23 years old. Daniel has also been called up to Nigeria’s Super Eagles Team B (CHAN Eagles) and has contributed to his club with key performances, including three goals this season​

Playerdis.name: Samuel Chukwueze
Playerdis.dic: Samuel Chukwueze is a Nigerian professional footballer who plays as a right winger for AC Milan and the Nigeria national team. Born on May 22, 1999, he started his career at Diamond Football Academy before moving to Villarreal CF in 2017. Known for his pace, dribbling, and left-footed finishing, he played a key role in Villarreal’s 2021 UEFA Europa League victory. In 2023, he transferred to AC Milan. Chukwueze also represents Nigeria internationally, having won the 2015 FIFA U-17 World Cup and competed in AFCON tournaments.

Playerdis.name: Victor Osimehn
Playerdis.dic: Victor Osimhen is a Nigerian professional footballer who plays as a striker for Napoli and the Nigeria national team. Born on December 29, 1998, he is known for his pace, strength, and goal-scoring ability. Osimhen began his career at Lille before moving to Napoli in 2020 for a club-record fee. He played a key role in Napoli’s 2022–23 Serie A title win, becoming the league’s top scorer. He has also been a crucial player for Nigeria, winning the 2015 FIFA U-17 World Cup and competing in AFCON tournaments.

Playerdis.name: Ademola Lokman
Playerdis.dic: Ademola Lookman is a Nigerian professional footballer who plays as a winger for Atalanta and the Nigeria national team. Born on October 20, 1997, in England, he started his career at Charlton Athletic before moving to Everton. He later played for RB Leipzig, Fulham, and Leicester City before joining Atalanta in 2022. Lookman is known for his dribbling, pace, and finishing. He switched his international allegiance from England to Nigeria in 2022 and has since become a key player for the Super Eagles.

Playerdis.name: Victor Boniface
Playerdis.dic: Victor Boniface is a Nigerian professional footballer who plays as a striker for Bayer Leverkusen and the Nigeria national team. Born on December 23, 2000, he is known for his strength, pace, and goal-scoring ability. Boniface started his career in Norway with Bodø/Glimt before moving to Union Saint-Gilloise (Belgium). In 2023, he signed with Bayer Leverkusen, where he has been a key player in their attack. He made his Nigeria national team debut in 2023 and is regarded as one of Africa’s top young forwards.

Playerdis.name: Simon Moses
Playerdis.dic: Moses Simon is a Nigerian professional footballer who plays as a winger for Nantes and the Nigeria national team. Born on July 12, 1995, he is known for his pace, dribbling, and crossing ability. Simon started his European career at Trenčín (Slovakia) before moving to KAA Gent (Belgium) and later Levante (Spain). He joined Nantes (France) in 2020, where he helped them win the 2021–22 Coupe de France. Simon has been a key player for Nigeria, representing the Super Eagles in multiple AFCON

Playerdis.name: Sadiq Umar
Playerdis.dic: Sadiq Umar is a Nigerian professional footballer who plays as a striker for Real Sociedad and the Nigeria national team. Born on February 2, 1997, he is known for his height (1.92m), strength, and goal-scoring ability. Umar started his European career with AS Roma, later playing for Perugia, Torino, NAC Breda, Partizan, and Almería. In 2022, he joined Real Sociedad in Spain’s La Liga. He has represented Nigeria, winning a bronze medal at the 2016 Olympics and featuring in AFCON tournaments.

Playerdis.name: Nathan Tella
Playerdis.dic: Nathan Tella is a Nigerian professional footballer who plays as a winger for Bayer Leverkusen and the Nigeria national team. Born on July 5, 1999, in England, he developed through Arsenal’s youth academy before joining Southampton in 2017. After a successful loan spell at Burnley, he transferred to Bayer Leverkusen in 2023. Tella is known for his speed, dribbling, and versatility. He switched his international allegiance from England to Nigeria in 2023 and made his debut for the Super Eagles.

Playerdis.name: Tolu Arokodare
Playerdis.dic: olu Arokodare is a Nigerian professional footballer who plays as a striker for KRC Genk in the Belgian Pro League. Born on November 23, 2000, he is known for his height (1.97m), aerial ability, and physical presence in attack. Arokodare started his professional career in Latvia with Valmiera before moving to Amiens (France). In 2023, he joined Genk, where he has continued to develop as a key forward.
